API ReferenceBusiness Insights APICustom ApplicationsCreate a Custom App
Create a Custom App
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/customapps

This endpoint creates a custom application.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: <= 128 characters

Example: Salesforce CRM
description
string
REQUIRED

Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

Possible values: <= 1024 characters

Example: Tracks all Salesforce CRM traffic
signatures
object[]
REQUIRED
Examples
Create a custom app with HOST signatures
Responses
​
201
400
401
403
405
415
429
500

Custom application created successfully.

Schema
Example (auto)
default

Array [
id
int32
Example: 101

string
REQUIRED

Possible values: <= 128 characters

Example: Salesforce CRM
associatedAppName
string

Associated application name (server-assigned).

Example: Salesforce
associatedAppCategory
string

Associated application category (server-assigned).

Example: CRM
description
string
REQUIRED

Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

Possible values: <= 1024 characters
